name: ntfy-go
description: Go port of the six ntfy Python sidecars (syslog-bridge, rss-gateway, github-rss, notify-broker, digest, topic-scanner) as ONE static binary, shadow stage: runs next to the Python sidecars on its own ports and containers, every sender in dry-run, outside every request path (ticket #1878)

native_build._doc: Multi-stage: compiled in golang:1.24-bookworm on the arch-matched runner (oci-apps is arm64), shipped as one static binary on distroless static (no shell, no libc, non-root 65532, CA bundle included for the GitHub TLS fetch). modernc.org/sqlite is pure Go, so CGO stays off. Same template as infra-ops_c3bot-relay-go.

api.description: Same contracts as the Python sidecars: rss-gateway /feed/*, topic-scanner / and /health, notify-broker /event /ack /health. Shadow stage: dry-run senders.

parity-compare._doc: Reference = the original Python sidecars (infra-obs_ntfy/src/code, unmodified) driven through parity/ref.py. Broker decide() over 12000 generated event steps on four policies, digest summarize()/read_history(), the topic scanner, the GitHub Atom parser and classifier, the syslog alert parser and the whole RSS gateway HTTP surface must be identical. See parity/parity_test.go.

_doc_shadow: Shadow stage (#1878). The live Python sidecars (containers syslog-bridge, rss-gateway, github-rss of the ntfy service) are untouched. These containers run the Go binary with NTFY_DRY_RUN=1: every sender logs what it WOULD publish and never reaches a ntfy topic, so no notification is duplicated. rss-gateway and topic-scanner only READ (ntfy poll, cache.db) on their own ports. The broker keeps its state on a tmpfs, never in the live notify state file. Switch-over (real publishing, public route for the gateway) is a separate step after the shadow has run clean next to the Python sidecars.
_doc_addressing: No mesh name, no Caddy route and no client wiring on purpose during the shadow stage: only the containers themselves and operators on the mesh dial the bind addresses (10.0.0.6:8191 gateway, :8192 scanner, :8193 broker), so no Hickory row and no Caddy fallback-map entry are needed.
